finding.headline: "Printable Feeding/Sleep Log for Paediatrician Visits"
finding.problem: "At the weigh-in the doctor asked 'how many feeds?' and I froze. My phone app is a mess and my husband's phone doesn't sync."
finding.person: Mum tracking feeds/diapers/sleep but apps feel like one more screen; wants a printable log she can hand the doctor — and her husband can't access the app.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Bonus / free gift (printable tracker pack).". Verdict: PASSES.
